description: This file defines the interface for the FreeType glyph dictionary services, including function types, service structure, and macros for defining the service.

classes.name: GlyphDict
classes.description: Service structure providing functions to retrieve glyph names and find glyph name indices.

methods.name: FT_GlyphDict_GetNameFunc
methods.description: Function pointer type for retrieving a glyph name given a face and glyph index.

methods.name: FT_GlyphDict_NameIndexFunc
methods.description: Function pointer type for retrieving a glyph index given a face and glyph name.
